verdict.rationale: Bento documents first-party SDKs across many languages, including JavaScript, Node.js, Next.js, Ruby, PHP, Laravel, Python, Go, .NET, Rust and Swift. Its docs pair the SDKs with an API reference and a Postman collection, and Bento Skills tells AI agents when to use an SDK. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality and depth, and per-SDK reference detail in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: We maintain first-party packages for JavaScript, Ruby, PHP, Laravel, WordPress, WooCommerce, and Next.js.
Bento has SDKs for JavaScript, Node.js, Next.js, Ruby, PHP, Laravel, WordPress, WooCommerce, Python, Go, .NET, Rust, Swift, Meteor.js, and Supabase.
Bento Skills tells the agent when to use Bento MCP, the CLI, an SDK, or n8n.
